ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher per NS-7; note on the driver's record that the trip was cancelled without the required "I'm Here" arrival confirmation (NS-1(i)), and remind the driver that arrival and waiting-fee conditions must be evidenced by the in-app button.

rejected_claims.reason: Not contested as fact, but presence at the pickup point (33 m closest approach [F1]) does not satisfy NS-1(i), which requires the driver to have pressed 'I'm Here'; the system record shows no such tap [F6][NS-1].

Long waiting time is accepted (5 min 20 s within 200 m [F2][F5]), but NS-1(iii) is only reached once (i) and (ii) are met, and NS-2 states the fee fails if any of the three is unfulfilled [F6][NS-1][NS-2].
The rider's 'on my way down' phrase is a party statement with no system record of her position, and it cannot cure the missing arrival-button precondition [F6][F11][NS-1].
NS-1(i) is an express precondition; GPS evidence of presence is not a substitute for the required tap. The unchallenged system record shows no tap [F6][F11][NS-1][NS-2].
That the $6.61 is the published amount with no surge [F7][F8] does not establish chargeability; chargeability is governed by NS-1/NS-2, where the condition precedent failed [F6][NS-1][NS-2].
Agreed and immaterial: no incidents and fair weather [F12][F13][F14] do not supply the missing NS-1(i) tap [F6][NS-1].
The rider's clean profile [F15] is a profile fact only and cannot decide the case; the outcome rests on the missing tap [F6][NS-2].
Accepted insofar as no flag_account arises, but for the reason that no 'I'm Here' tap was made at all (no false arrival-button use) [F6][NS-2].
